notes: Both articles of בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת go unrepresented because the ASV writes only 'at this time': the demonstrative morpheme זֹאת is what licenses 'this', so rule 41's determiner clause is blocked by its own 'only where no other morpheme licenses that determiner' limit.
The italic 'it' of 'that they may feel it' is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause, and rule 44 bars folding a supplied object into the verb's rendering.
